product_identity.name: eFactory One
product_identity.domain: German-first academic ghostwriting marketplace (DACH); UI English-first with localization (D-12)
product_identity.problem_statement: Replace Berat's manual orchestration across Google Sheets, Notion, 17 WordPress CF7 forms, Zapier→Pipedrive, Outlook, and WhatsApp with one operator-centric platform while keeping Pipedrive as CRM SoT and Sevdesk as legal invoicing SoT.
product_identity.design_north_star_from_docs: Operator-mediated operations console (explorations/product_ux_workflow_discussion.md §0): the Order is the atomic unit; Admin is the financial firewall, QA gate, assignment intelligence, and dispute resolver; thin Customer/GW surfaces.

binding.summary: Pipedrive remains CRM SoT — platform mirrors via API
Sevdesk remains invoicing/accounting SoT — proposals/invoices via API
Replace Zapier before 2026-07-31
No production code until requirements + Figma signed off
Team owns all naming — no AI-generated names without sign-off
Stripe webhook is authoritative paid trigger — do not poll Sevdesk for payment
Bank transfer Mark-as-Paid calls same confirmPayment() as Stripe
GW selection not fully automated v1 — Berat approves
Guest flow for WhatsApp leads — account after offer acceptance/payment
Flamingo analytics = Phase 0 quick win, separate from main build
Unified chat = canonical comms view across media
English-first app; all copy in i18n files
International markets architecturally supported (currency, tax, rails)
Whitelist/blacklist all considered options in docs (TC-01)
Inbound email via Cloudflare Email Workers → HTTP to backend
Voice: metadata only — no recordings, no transcriptions
Inbox/chat order-centric — thread parent is order_id
Pre-order contacts = person threads (phone/name), linkable to customer/order
Mentions → notifications model; no separate Mentions inbox section
Pipeline Kanban: Inquiry/Qualified hide money; Proposal+ show amounts; naming aligned Sevdesk

feature: eFactory One — production platform replacing manual ops and Zapier while preserving Pipedrive + Sevdesk + Stripe truth lines
goal: Ship an operator-centric order-to-payout platform that implements German business rules and GW SOPs from docs/, terminates Zapier reliance by 2026-07-31, ingests comms into an order-centric unified model (D-11/D-17), and stays architecturally ready for i18n (D-12/D-13) — with the JSX prototype informing UX only.

requirements_sources.note: Authoritative product truth is docs/*.md per team_conventions TC-04. Prototype + PRD.json describe intended screens and demo data, not committed backend design.

prototype_architecture.router: Hash URL #/{role}/{routeName}?params — parseHash/buildHash in src/core/routes.js; index.html App syncs history.
prototype_architecture.stack: React 18 UMD + Babel standalone; no build step; scripts load order in index.html (data → workflow → entities → store → actions → hooks → routes → role views).
prototype_architecture.shell: shell.jsx: Sidebar + Topbar (search, Friday widget admin-only, NotifBell, RoleSwitcher); customer role renders standalone shell without ops sidebar.
prototype_architecture.persistence: In-memory only; reload resets. No localStorage mirroring per IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.
prototype_architecture.realtime_model: Single-tab: next render sees prior actions when switching persona.
prototype_architecture.dev_tools: src/dev/tweaks-panel.jsx theme/density/locale toggles; optional in production builds.
non_goals: Server-authoritative workflow enforcement (client can patch; production must gate on API)

d20_money_visibility.canShowMoney: isPreProposal(status) === false — money hidden for lead/qualified (aligns D-20 with pipeline).
d20_money_visibility.canShowReceivable: Hidden for pre-proposal and for offer_sent/cancelled/bye.

release_gates.description: releaseGates(order) in workflow.js — releasable only when status === payment_pending AND all five gates pass.
release_gates.quality_approved_rule: qaPassed true, not flagged, not in ai_violation_review or plagiarism_violation_review
release_gates.installments_rule: all installments status paid AND outstandingEur === 0

prototype_state_machine.assignment_guard: canAssign: rejects pre-payment and post-final/cancelled orders.
prototype_state_machine.release_gate_stage_notes: Per-status human explanations via releaseGateStageNote() for in-app gate widget copy.
prototype_state_machine.production_requirement: Every transition that mutates money, assignment, or legal state must be re-validated server-side; client TRANSITIONS are UX guards only.

Pipedrive subscriber banner (shell.jsx AdminGlobalBanners) is UX-only; production needs PP-01 hygiene + real subscriber API.
Friday releaseBatch transitions orders to completed in demo; production needs ledger entries, payout export, and GW banking reconciliation.
Delay flow GW report-delay may still use checkbox “customer informed”; open_questions G-05 may require explicit customer confirmation — reconcile before legal sign-off.
assign_gw transition references paid_assignment_started (workflow.js) — verify parity with ORDER_STATES and docs lifecycle naming; normalize on server.
